episode_summary: In this episode, Austin Clarence discusses the impact of global oil prices on mortgage rates and the potential for rate cuts by the Federal Reserve. He highlights specialty loan programs for doctors, veterans, and self-employed individuals, offering actionable insights for real estate agents to better serve their clients. The episode emphasizes the importance of understanding niche loan products to differentiate in the market.
